If you can share roughly how many orders/tickets you handle weekly, I can narrow it down.

attempts.text:
Here’s a lightweight one-week pilot (starting Monday 16 Nov):

**Monday — Set up rules**
- Pick 3–4 ticket categories (e.g., “Where’s my order,” “Damaged item,” “Product question,” “Returns/refund”).
- Define simple routing rules (keywords, sender, order status) and who owns each queue.
- Turn on auto-tagging only—no auto-replies yet.

**Tuesday — Parallel run**
- Run the automation in draft/sandbox mode on yesterday’s tickets.
- Compare its tags/assignments against what your team would have done. Note mismatches.

**Wednesday — Live pilot with human review**
- Enable auto-tagging and auto-assignment on new tickets, but require a human to send the first reply.
- Add a quick internal note template so the assignee can confirm or correct the category.

**Thursday — Review & tune**
- Check misclassified tickets. Adjust keywords or routing rules.
- Decide if any category is safe for an auto-reply (e.g., order-status lookup with tracking link).

**Friday — Go/no-go**
- Metrics to check: % auto-tagged correctly, time saved on sorting, any missed urgent tickets.
- If accuracy is >90%, extend for another week; otherwise, refine rules or hold off.

**Caveat:** I don’t know your helpdesk platform or ticket volume, so you’ll need to adapt the tool-specific steps. If you tell me which system you use, I can make it more concrete.

**One-Week Triage Automation Pilot Checklist**

**Monday — Set up rules**
- [ ] Pick 3–4 ticket categories (e.g., “Where’s my order,” “Damaged item,” “Product question,” “Returns/refund”)
- [ ] Define routing rules (keywords, sender, order status) and queue owners
- [ ] Enable auto-tagging only (no auto-replies)

**Tuesday — Parallel run**
- [ ] Run automation in draft/sandbox mode on yesterday’s tickets
- [ ] Compare auto-tags/assignments vs. manual decisions
- [ ] Log mismatches

**Wednesday — Live pilot with human review**
- [ ] Enable auto-tagging + auto-assignment on new tickets
- [ ] Require human to send first reply
- [ ] Add internal note template for assignee to confirm/correct category

**Thursday — Review & tune**
- [ ] Review misclassified tickets
- [ ] Adjust keywords/routing rules
- [ ] Identify any category safe for auto-reply (e.g., order-status with tracking link)

**Friday — Go/no-go**
- [ ] Measure: % auto-tagged correctly, time saved on sorting, missed urgent tickets
- [ ] Decision: extend another week if accuracy >90%, else refine rules or pause

**Ongoing**
- [ ] Document final rules in shared doc
- [ ] Schedule weekly 15-min review for first month
